evidence: Inscr. Mur. 1134.3 (Lewis & Short): mamma for a grandmother
terms.comment: The nursery word for mother; Lewis & Short cite one inscription where it names a grandmother. Fine for a child to say, but avia is the word.

sources: The grouped card gave no source for this word.
